sections.text: Monitored pressure in XT cross. Siwhp decreased slowly and stabilized at 26 bar. Cycled HMV and MMV every 1-1,5 hours. Meanwhile flushed kill and cement manifold with cement unit. Attempted to pressure test cement unit.
Continued monitoring pressure in XT cross, siwhp 49 bar. Bled down to 30 bar through closed drain. Continued cycling HMV and MMV every 1-1,5 hours. Meanwhile attempted to pressure test cement unit.
Continued monitoring pressure in XT cross, siwhp 48,6 bar. Bled down to 32,6 bar through closed drain. Continued cycling HMV and MMV every 1-1,5 hours.
Pressure tested BOP meanwhile monitored pressure in XT cross. Bled off from 50 to 30,5bar. Continued to cycle HMV and MMV every 1-1,5 hours.
Performed TBT for inflow test and pressure test cement plug

Opened SV and pressured up to 50 bar with cement unit to equalize opened HMV. Pressured up well to 310bar, 680ltr pumped from 47 bar to 310 bar. Closed SV and bled off pressure in XT cross through closed drain.

Bled down pressure to 40 bar through closed drain. Continued bleeding down to 10 bar in steps of 10 bar. Monitored pressure for 10 minute at each step. Inflow tested cement plug to 38 bar differential for 30min.
Equalized pressure and opened SV. Pressured up well to 255 bar using cement unit. Closed SV closed DHSV, bled off 340ml control fluid from control line. Bled off well to 185 bar through closed drain.
Attempted to inflow test DHSV to 70bar/30min.
Bled down pressure in well to 10 bar through closed drain attempted to inflow tested DHSV to 245bar/30min.
Pressured up well to 100 bar, 240lts pumped. Volume pumped iindicated that the DHSV was open. Evaluated situation.
Performed TBT for inflow test of DHSV with all involved personnel
Prepared to inflow test DHSV. Prepared drums for volume control on cantilever. Altus prepared drain line from top of cement spool to cantilever.

Pressured up well to 255bar with cement unit, 375 lts pumped from 100 to 255 bar. Totally pumped 615lts from 10 to 255 bar. No indication on test pump that DHSV opened. Bled off control line to DHSV, volume bled back 340ml.
Closed swab valve and bled off well to 234 bar, 100 lts bled back. Bled off additional 85 lts, well pressure 185 bar.
Pressured up DHSV control line to 400bar. Bled off entire well to 30 bar through closed drain. Pressured up well to 256 bar with cement unit, 604ltr pumped.
